description: On a wide page, the snippet docks Shelley on the right. The page http://app.test/ (title "App", an h1 "App") has the Edit with Shelley snippet: a details element ".edit-with-shelley" whose summary "Edit with Shelley" opens Shelley in an iframe with title "Shelley" ("the frame"), loaded lazily. Call "frame loads" counts the requests for Shelley's page / so far. A new frame loads all of Shelley, which can take a while: wait for it. Perform the steps in order. 1. Navigate to http://app.test/. 2. The summary ".edit-with-shelley summary" should be visible with exactly the text "Edit with Shelley". 3. Call "frame loads": it must return exactly "0" (closed, the frame loads nothing). 4. The button is at the top right: eval (() => { const r = document.querySelector('.edit-with-shelley summary').getBoundingClientRect(); return r.top < 24 && innerWidth - r.right < 24; })() expecting true. 5. Click the summary. 6. In the frame, [data-testid="message-input"] should be visible. 7. The page makes room for the frame: eval getComputedStyle(document.documentElement).marginRight expecting "480px". 8. The frame fills the right edge, 480px wide: eval (() => { const r = document.querySelector('iframe[title=Shelley]').getBoundingClientRect(); return [r.top, r.right === innerWidth, r.width, r.height === innerHeight].join(' '); })() expecting "0 true 480 true". 9. The button sits just left of the frame: eval (() => { const b = document.querySelector('.edit-with-shelley summary').getBoundingClientRect(); const f = document.querySelector('iframe[title=Shelley]').getBoundingClientRect(); return b.right <= f.left && f.left - b.right < 24; })() expecting true. 10. Click the summary again. 11. The frame must not be visible, and eval getComputedStyle(document.documentElement).marginRight expecting "0px".
